simple.summary: נְבַלָּט (Nᵉballâṭ) means Neballat , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: Neh 11 34.

definitions.full: H5041. Neballat נְבַלָּ֑ט proper name, of a location place where Benjamites dwelt Neh 11:34 . ᵐ5 L Ναβαλυτ . Modern Beit Nebâlâ, 6 miles northeast from Lydda, according to Guérin Sam. ii. 67 f. ; Mishna נבלטא בית Buhl Ges 12; Geogr. 197 .
